title: India 🇮🇳 has more people online than these 6 countries
headline: India vs *6 countries* online
description: India's internet users against America, Brazil, Russia, Japan, Germany and the UK put together. Who has more? Real World Bank data for 2024. Comment your flag.
source: World Bank, internet users (% of population) x population (2024), data.worldbank.org

hi.title: भारत 🇮🇳 में इन 6 देशों से ज़्यादा लोग ऑनलाइन
hi.description: भारत के इंटरनेट यूज़र बनाम अमेरिका, ब्राज़ील, रूस, जापान, जर्मनी और ब्रिटेन मिलाकर। असली आंकड़े, 2024। अपना झंडा कमेंट करें।

segments.text: Nine hundred forty-two million people online. This is India.
Now add Japan. And Germany. And the UK. India still has more. By fifty-five million.

props.caption: more Indians online than all six combined

segments.text: Only China has more. Where is your country?
